description: Fermate autobus urbani del comune di Matera is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Matera. Dal 14 giugno 2017 sono stati aggiunti i dati sulle fermate dei "Bus Urbani" di fonte Miccolis S.p.A. ed Ufficio Traffico del Comune elaborati da Uff. Statistica. MAPPA. Coverage: Comune di Matera. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Matera. Its tags are autobus, fermate-autobus, trasporti-pubblici, trasporti-urbani. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
